dct_description_sm: The purpose of this report is to provide a review of fish resources of the Mackenzie Delta and nearshore Beaufort Sea. The report includes an annotated bibliography, documentation of unpublished information, an analysis of commercial, domestic, and sport fisheries, a synthesis of the present fishery management, resource development potential, and recommendations for future biological studies necessary for fishery management.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Management
dct_title_s: A review of the fisheries of the Mackenzie Delta and nearshore Beaufort Sea
